text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, August 29, 2018 Posted by admin on August 29th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Apple (AAPL), American Express (AXP), Cisco (CSCO), UnitedHealth (UNH) and Visa (V). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -14 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +14.38 (+0.06%) at 26,064.02.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.44%.
There were 26 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Walmart (WMT) +1.62% and Apple (AAPL) +0.81%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Boeing (BA) -0.72% and Coca Cola (KO) -0.70%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up two-tenths of a cent at $2.837 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
UnitedHealth (UNH)
UnitedHealth (UNH) is up +21.80% year-to-date.
